cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: For Stability’s Sake
cards.instruction: Hide a destabilizing truth because you believe the current balance of power must be protected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Leave the director's name on the launch programme. The department heads need someone above them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Her resignation is in the printer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Put it in my drawer. Without her, they'll each claim the launch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're asking which of them gets her opening speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll read it on her behalf. Give them equal introductions; nobody inherits the microphone.
